answer: The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in bridge, expire in violet, and ridge lists each expiry. An attacker running 66 aliases hence needs 109 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3039 identities would post 4233 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
